exhibits.title: PROTOCOL DECAY: TOKYO 2025
exhibits.summary: The first Protocol Decay, hosted by NOX Gallery during Art Golden Gai and NFT Japan 2025; presented by ArtBees Gallery and Superchief.

exhibits.title: PROTOCOL DECAY: CRAIOVA 2025
exhibits.summary: The second Protocol Decay, hosted by Arta 2 Gallery and presented by ArtBees Gallery, with a live performance by DJ Anrei YC.

exhibits.title: PROTOCOL DECAY: NYC 2025
exhibits.summary: The third Protocol Decay, hosted at Lume Studios and presented as a dedicated screen curation by The Canal Street Show, PepeEternal, and Efdot.

exhibits.title: PROTOCOL DECAY: MARFA 2025
exhibits.summary: The fourth Protocol Decay, staged in a Texas church during Art Blocks Weekend 2025 and hosted by Desultor.

known_gaps: Verified social avatars, biographies, and style statements remain incomplete for profiles not directly supported by inspected artist sources.
Legacy first-party artwork tiles and large installation galleries are indexed, but their old wp-content URLs now return 404; only previously archived originals are served locally.
The first-party Marfa page says 18 October 2025 while the cited social post is dated 25 October 2025; both claims are retained for review.
The Marfa poster carried a stale NYC caption in the legacy page; local association is based on section placement and the October asset path.
